value.rationale: A finite allowance of resetting events is the central resource in the source model, which explicitly observes an unexplained shape change of the mean terminal duration. An exact universal smallest budget separates entirely monotone profiles from those admitting two opposite slope reversals, and the result specifies the first critical integer without interpolating plots. This is a natural complete cutoff rather than an arbitrary numerical tabulation; the physical distinction between abort-time and successful target finding is explicit.
